title: Which Direction? → Where on the Curve?
description: An interactive, scroll-driven tutorial on the Quadratic Quasi-Newton (QQN) optimizer. Reframes optimization from "which direction should I move?" into "where on this curve should I stop?" — with live contour maps, deformable search curves, and a four-axis factoring that collapses a zoo of classical methods (gradient descent, momentum, L-BFGS, trust regions, OWL-QN) into points in one configuration space. Built to make the geometry something you can feel, not just read.
subtitle: Interactive · optimization
